sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO biological specimen records and source donor IDs; all repeated patient IDs stay linked.

source_metadata.access: Public GEO processed count matrices; controlled raw sequence access not required

title: PBMC, healthy, 1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: Peripheral blood immune cells
extract_protocol_ch1: Isolated PBMCs were loaded into a 10× Chromium Chip (v3.1 PN:1000120) and barcoded using a 10x Chromium Controller.

RNA from the barcoded cells was then reverse-transcribed, amplified, and prepared into sequencing libraries with the 10× Library Construction Kit (v3.1 PN:1000190) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
data_processing: Raw scRNA-seq data were initially pre-processed using CellRanger (version 8.0.1, 10x Genomics) to align reads to the human genome (GRCh38, 2024-A from 10x Genomics) and count the unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) for each gene to generate specific gene cell count tables. For each scRNA-seq sample, the count tables were filtered to retain the genes detected in at least 10 cells and cells with a minimum gene count of 300.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: barcodes, features, and matrix files for each samples
contact_institute: Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica Chinese Academy of Sciences
contact_address: Life Science Research Building 320 Yueyang Road, Xuhui District

RNA from the barcoded cells was then reverse-transcribed, amplified, and prepared into sequencing libraries with the 10× Library Construction Kit (v3.1 PN:1000190) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
data_processing: Raw scRNA-seq data were initially pre-processed using CellRanger (version 8.0.1, 10x Genomics) to align reads to the human genome (GRCh38, 2024-A from 10x Genomics) and count the unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) for each gene to generate specific gene cell count tables. For each scRNA-seq sample, the count tables were filtered to retain the genes detected in at least 10 cells and cells with a minimum gene count of 300.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: barcodes, features, and matrix files for each samples
contact_institute: Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica Chinese Academy of Sciences
contact_address: Life Science Research Building 320 Yueyang Road, Xuhui District
